answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 29364 Country: India Title: Alhamdulillah we are expecting our first child. My wife has just got pregnant. please let me know any wazifa or dua for her/us for getting the things easier and make our child dean-daar, intelligent and healthy. Question: Asak Mufti sb, Alhamdulillah we are expecting our first child. My wife has just got pregnant. please let me know any wazifa or dua for her/us for getting the things easier and make our child dean-daar, intelligent and healthy. JazakAllah Answer ID: 29364 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 236/221/B=1432) If you wish for a boy, keep on reciting the following dua extensively: اللهم ارزقني ولدًا صالحًا . (2) When the time of birth start, write the following ayah on a piece of paper and wrap it in clean cloth and tie it on the thigh of the woman and untie it immediately followed birth: إِذَا السَّمَاء انشَقَّتْ ، وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ ، وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ ، وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ . Note: You should carefully mind untying the tawiz just after birth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
